question: What dual boon is Yamunā asked to grant the devotee?
premises: Yamunā is called giver of deathlessness
The prayer asks her to be so
inference: Yamunā is prayed to subdue pride and grant deathlessness.
uncertainties: maya may mean pride or delusion; yama+tva+dā may mean giving restraint or freedom from death
plain_english: May Yamunā, subduer of pride, be the giver of deathlessness.
